items.source: Sets the default view class to requiredViewClass(): by default FreeMarkerView.
items.translation: 将默认的view class设置为requiredViewClass()：默认为FreeMarkerView。

items.source: Delegates to super.loadView(viewName, locale) for standard behavior and then to postProcessView(FreeMarkerView) for customization.
items.translation: 委托给super.loadView(viewName, locale)以执行标准行为，然后委托给postProcessView(FreeMarkerView)以实现自定义。

items.source: Note: To ensure that the correct encoding is used when the rendering the response, set the content type with an appropriate charset attribute — for example, "text/html;charset=UTF-8"; however, it is not necessary to explicitly set the content type in the FreeMarkerViewResolver if you have set an explicit encoding via either FreeMarkerView.setEncoding(String), FreeMarkerConfigurationFactory.setDefaultEncoding(String), or Configuration.setDefaultEncoding(String).
items.translation: 注意： 为确保渲染响应时使用正确的编码，请设置带有适当 charset 属性的 content type——例如，"text/html;charset=UTF-8"；但是，如果您已通过 FreeMarkerView.setEncoding(String)、FreeMarkerConfigurationFactory.setDefaultEncoding(String) 或 Configuration.setDefaultEncoding(String) 显式设置了编码，则无需在 FreeMarkerViewResolver 中显式设置 content type。

items.source: The default implementation attempts to override the content type of the view with "text/html;charset=<encoding>", where <encoding> is equal to an explicitly configured character encoding for the underlying FreeMarker template file. If an explicit content type has been configured for this view resolver or if no explicit character encoding has been configured for the template file, this method does not modify the supplied FreeMarkerView.
items.translation: 默认实现尝试将视图的内容类型覆盖为"text/html;charset=<encoding>"，其中<encoding>等于底层 FreeMarker 模板文件显式配置的字符编码。如果为此视图解析器配置了显式的内容类型，或者未为模板文件配置显式的字符编码，则此方法不会修改提供的FreeMarkerView。

items.source: Note: When chaining ViewResolvers, a FreeMarkerViewResolver will check for the existence of the specified template resources and only return a non-null View object if the template was actually found.
items.translation: 注意： 在链式使用 ViewResolvers 时，FreeMarkerViewResolver 会检查指定模板资源是否存在，仅当实际找到该模板时才返回非 null 的 View 对象。

items.source: The view class for all views generated by this resolver can be specified via the "viewClass" property. See UrlBasedViewResolver for details.
items.translation: 由该解析器生成的所有视图的视图类可以通过 "viewClass" 属性指定。有关详细信息，请参阅UrlBasedViewResolver。
